name: Metope
description: The plain panel between triglyphs, flanked by its two thin rules.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 24%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 4%, #000 4% 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 90%, #000 90% 96%, transparent 96%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 4%, #000 4% 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 90%, #000 90% 96%, transparent 96%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
